prompt: Improve whether source-skill.md is selected for the right requests in cases.json. Tune only on train cases and report only the holdout result. Write out/revised-skill.md and out/trigger-report.json. Change only the front-matter description, not the skill body. The description must capture positive triggers and near-miss exclusions without becoming a long procedure. The report must include each holdout id and boolean invoke prediction, heldout_accuracy, tuned_on, and reported_on.
rubric: The description is concise and discriminating, separates OpenAPI reference generation from adjacent writing tasks, preserves the skill body, respects the train and holdout split, and reports the held-out result accurately.

source_failure.signature: broad skill descriptions over-trigger on adjacent writing requests and hide held-out regressions
